Thought: Hexafluoroethane (C₂F₆) has a staggered conformation with a 3-fold rotation axis along the C-C bond, three C₂ axes perpendicular to the C₃ axis, three mirror planes, and a center of inversion. These symmetry elements correspond to the D₃d point group.
